tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background: washi paper in light, sumi-ink black in dark. Ground for ink, ink-muted, ink-subtle and vermilion text.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, example-word lists, sheets and widgets sitting on surface. Ink, ink-muted, ink-subtle and vermilion text all read on it.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells and inset areas such as the drawing pad and calendar cells. Use ink and ink-muted on it, not ink-subtle.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and every kanji glyph, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: readings labels, meanings in lists, helper copy. On surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, inactive tab labels and placeholders. On surface and surface-raised only.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines. Decorative only; never the only boundary of an interactive control (use border-control).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of secondary buttons, toggles and inputs. At least 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: vermilion
tokens.usage: The one accent (hanko-stamp red): primary button fill, active tab, progress ring, check-in dots and the brand mark. Also text on surface and surface-raised. One vermilion fill per view.

tokens.name: vermilion-hover
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of vermilion fills; tone-on-tone glyph on the cover.

tokens.name: on-vermilion
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a vermilion fill. Dark text in the dark theme because vermilion is lightened there.

tokens.name: vermilion-wash
tokens.usage: Quiet tinted fill for the learned state and selected rows. Vermilion text reads on it.

tokens.name: matcha
tokens.usage: Known and complete status (marked-known kanji, finished level). Always paired with a word or check mark. Text on surface, surface-raised and matcha-wash.

tokens.name: matcha-wash
tokens.usage: Background for matcha badges.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Information and links (ai-zome blue). Also the focus ring. Text on surface, surface-raised and indigo-wash.

tokens.name: indigo-wash
tokens.usage: Background for informational banners and indigo badges.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px keyboard and Switch Control focus ring, offset 2px; 3:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

families.gothic: "Zen Kaku Gothic New", "Hiragino Sans", "Yu Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: kanji-hero
styles.usage: The kanji of the day on the Today tab and detail page.

styles.name: kanji-large
styles.usage: Kanji in search results, history rows and the flashcard front.

styles.name: kanji-widget
styles.usage: Kanji in the small and medium home widgets.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small uppercase tags such as level and date labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon to label, reading to reading.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between related controls and list row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips and compact rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default screen margin and gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding and section spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space around the hero kanji.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Large separations on the Duo inner screen.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Stamp, badges and small tags; seal-like corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and list groups.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and widgets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Progress segments and toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting card on surface. Prefer a hairline border; use this only where a card floats over content.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and popovers only.
